Class_Skill_Desc_Battle Bell: Grants Battle Bell to self or target player.</br>Battle Bell Effect: Grants a stack of Battle's Clangor upon taking damage, up to a maximum of 8</br>Duration: 60s</br>Battle's Clangor Effect: Increases damage dealt by 5％</br>Duration: 30s
Class_Skill_Desc_Ringing Respite: Grants Ringing Respite to self or target player.</br>Ringing Respite Effect: Heals self or target player when damage is taken</br>Cure Potency: 3,000</br>Duration: 60s
Class_Skill_Desc_Suspend: Grants Suspend to self or target party member, becoming lighter than air and immune to certain mechanics.</br>Duration: 60s</br>Shares a recast timer with all other weaponskills and spells.
Class_Skill_Desc_Weather: Grants a beneficial effect to self and nearby party members based on the weather.</br>Sunbath Effect: Restores HP</br>Cloudy Caress Effect: Increases healing potency by 30%</br>Blessed Rain Effect: Erects a magicked barrier which nullifies damage</br>Misty Mirage Effect: Increases evasion by 40%</br>Hasty Mirage Effect: Increases movement speed by 20%</br>Aetherial Gain Effect: Increases damage dealt by 10%
Class_Trait_Desc_Enhanced Bell: Increases the effectiveness of Battle Bell to 5%, and increases the healing potency of Ringing Respite to 3,000.
